episodes.name: Beginnings (1)
episodes.overview: Two street kids are pursued by the S.P.D., a space patrol from the future whose job it is to protect Earth from evil aliens.

episodes.name: Beginnings (2)
episodes.overview: Jack and Z must decide whether or not to join the S.P.D. Emperor Gruumm sets his sights on Earth.

episodes.name: Confronted
episodes.overview: Jack lets being the leader go to his head. Gruumm lures the A Squad Rangers into space.

episodes.name: Walls
episodes.overview: Sky's refusal to accept Jack as the leader of the Rangers results in a victory for Gruumm.

episodes.name: Dogged
episodes.overview: Syd is the only one that believes R.I.C., the robotic dog, can still be a valuable asset to S.P.D.

episodes.name: A-Bridged
episodes.overview: The other Rangers are skeptical of Bridge's unusual investigative methods.

episodes.name: Sam (1)
episodes.overview: Mora uses a young boy with special powers in a plot to capture people and turn them into dolls.

episodes.name: Sam (2)
episodes.overview: Z befriends Sam, and teaches him to use his special powers for the good of mankind.

episodes.name: Idol
episodes.overview: Sky's loyalty to an old friend is put to the test when it is suspected that he is working for Gruumm.

episodes.name: Stakeout
episodes.overview: Syd is angry with Jack when she makes him work on her birthday.

episodes.name: Shadow (1)
episodes.overview: Cruger must face the demons of his past when an old enemy returns.

episodes.name: Shadow (2)
episodes.overview: Cruger is challenged by an old foe and must overcome his reluctance to fight.

episodes.name: Abandoned
episodes.overview: Cruger refuses to help the Rangers fight Dracel; Gruumm goes after the Stone of Evil.

episodes.name: Wired (1)
episodes.overview: A new recruit has SPD buzzing; Gruumm looks for a second in command.

episodes.name: Wired (2)
episodes.overview: The teens must find Sophie before Valko uses her to control Gorodon.

episodes.name: Boom
episodes.overview: Trouble results when Boom tells his visiting parents that he is a Power Ranger.

episodes.name: Recognition
episodes.overview: A dangerous alien criminal switches bodies with Sky.

episodes.name: Samurai
episodes.overview: Gruumm brings a noble warrior from the past and tricks him into battling the Rangers.

episodes.name: Dismissed
episodes.overview: Cruger is relieved from duty when he clashes with the tough SPD Supreme Commander.

episodes.name: Perspective
episodes.overview: The Rangers relate the capture of a criminal to Cruger, but they all have their own unique version of the story.

episodes.name: Messenger (1)
episodes.overview: The cadets get a message from the future that today is the day that they will lose the battle of Earth to the Troobians.

episodes.name: Messenger (2)
episodes.overview: A mysterious Ranger from the future comes to help the Rangers in their hour of need.

episodes.name: Zapped
episodes.overview: Morgana grants real power to a washed-up magician in her latest attempt to destroy the Rangers.

episodes.name: Reflection (1)
episodes.overview: Sky must interrogate a notorious criminal when aliens that SPD has already captured attack the Rangers.

episodes.name: Reflection (2)
episodes.overview: Sky must face off with the criminal who was responsible for the loss of his father.

episodes.name: S.W.A.T. (1)
episodes.overview: Piggy and friends steal SPD technology; the Rangers are sent to Zentor to train for SWAT mode.

episodes.name: S.W.A.T. (2)
episodes.overview: Under the command of a tough drill sergeant, the Rangers must learn to work as a team before they can earn a powerful new weapons' technology.

episodes.name: Robotpalooza
episodes.overview: The Rangers nearly reach their breaking point when both Gruumm and Broodwing send robot after robot to attack the city.

episodes.name: Impact
episodes.overview: Jack and Sky embark on a dangerous mission to stop an incoming meteor from destroying Earth.

episodes.name: Katastrophe
episodes.overview: Convinced that the Rangers no longer need her, Kat takes a top-level position at SPD Headquarters.

episodes.name: Missing
episodes.overview: Bridge is captured and the other Rangers must use all their skills to find him before he is destroyed.

episodes.name: History
episodes.overview: Broodwing brings the Dino Rangers from the past to fight on the side of evil.

episodes.name: Badge
episodes.overview: Cruger's old rival teams up with Broodwing to take down the Rangers one by one.

episodes.name: Insomnia
episodes.overview: The teens grapple with failure after Cruger hails the A squad.

episodes.name: Resurrection
episodes.overview: Jack needs to decide what he really wants to do with his life and the Rangers are dealt a shocking revelation.

episodes.name: Endings (1)
episodes.overview: With Cruger captured, the A Squad is sent by Gruumm to finish off the Rangers.

episodes.name: Endings (2)
episodes.overview: Omni descends to Earth and Gruumm makes his last stand against the Rangers.

episodes.name: Wormhole
episodes.overview: Gruumm takes The Terror to the past in an attempt to defeat Earth before SPD was formed.
